decision.summary: Close the bounded Codex hook repair after loader compatibility, direct command behavior, exact trust registration and global-setting preservation are observed.
alternatives: Leave the invalid advisory inactive and record the failure
Repair only the supported event schema, message and exact hook trust entry
counterevidence: Temporary-project hooks/list omitted the candidate; canonical-path discovery was required.
Automatic SessionStart event execution in an already-open client remains UNRUN.
assumptions: The user authorizes fixing hooks; the root authorized the exact supported-API trust entry after the loader showed untrusted.
decision.forecast: Fresh Codex sessions discover the trusted canonical SessionStart handler and can run its bounded reminder.
decision.falsifier: The canonical hook is missing/untrusted, output lacks valid context, or any unrelated global config differs.
acceptance: Original schema rejected by installed loader
Canonical repaired handler loaded without warnings/errors
Reviewed command returns valid advisory SessionStart context with exit 0
Exact handler enabled and trusted; unrelated global config semantically preserved
Bounded 13-section journal and source-bound receipt recorded
decision.rollback: Preserved original hook bytes have sha256 c101fbad0b4eb14ffef7c5ee7b7000509174fea0abeab2754abecdafc10643ae. Revoke only the new trust key using a fresh version-fenced config operation if rollback is required.
decision.reviewer: Codex hook implementer; root reviews evidence for the ecology integration, with no system admission.
decision.budget: No inference turns, no dependencies, one delegated worker, five-second command bound and 45-second app-server bound.
residuals: Automatic event execution and currently-open client reload are UNRUN.
No enforcement, production admission, full UI or full-system formal claim is made.
